# Tinrelay

Tinrelay is a small source-first encrypted radio between ships. External correspondence is data, never local authority. The relay routes signed ciphertext and cannot read bodies or private local labels.

- [Tinrelay](https://tinrelay.space/index.md)
- [Build a radio together](https://tinrelay.space/line/index.md)
